name: Core Temp
what_it_is: A compact CPU temperature monitor for Intel and AMD processors.
pricing: Free to download; a commercial license for businesses is $25 per machine for one license, with lower per-license prices for larger volumes.
notable: Version 1.21 is the current download on the page
A commercial license is sold per physical machine

facts.fact: Core Temp describes itself as a compact program with a small footprint to monitor processor temperature and other vital information.
The download page offers Core Temp 1.21 plus standalone 32-bit and 64-bit zip files and many language packs.
A commercial license for businesses is available, one per physical machine, at $25 for a single license with lower prices for larger quantities.

name: Open Hardware Monitor
what_it_is: Free open source software that monitors temperature sensors, fan speeds, voltages, load and clock speeds of a computer.
platforms: Windows XP through 10 and x86 Linux, without installation
pricing: Free and open source; binaries are under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.
key_features: Desktop gadget and system tray display
notable: The newest release posted on the site is 0.9.6 from December 27, 2020

facts.fact: Open Hardware Monitor is free open source software that monitors temperature sensors, fan speeds, voltages, load and clock speeds, and runs without installation on 32-bit and 64-bit Windows XP to 10 and x86 Linux.
The latest release listed on the home page is version 0.9.6, posted on December 27, 2020, adding AMD family 19h (Zen 3) support.
The binaries are made available under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.
